pages.text: Pleroma once asked for every fluid of the mod at once. Now each branch of knowledge is distilled into one fluid first, and the world into a fifth: $(fluid)Quintessence$() (Physics), $(fluid)Alkahest$() (Chemistry), $(fluid)Mathesis$() (Mathematics), $(fluid)Panacea$() (Biology) and $(fluid)Anima Mundi$() (the world).

$(fluid)Quintessence$(): in the $(item)Universe Forge$(), sixteen fluids of particles and matter make the $(fluid)Distillate of Forces$(), and sixteen of time and the cosmos the $(fluid)Distillate of Spacetime$(). The two, with the laws of physics, make Quintessence, with the $(item)Theory of Everything$() as catalyst.

$(fluid)Mathesis$(): in the $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$(), the fluids of chance, curvature and dimension, with a Riemann Zeta Crystal, a Topos and a Surreal Number, and $(item)Euler's Identity$() as catalyst.

$(fluid)Panacea$(): in the $(item)Abiogenesis Crucible$(), every fluid of life, a Resolved Anomaly and an Immortal Cell Line, with the $(item)Tree of Life$() as catalyst. $(fluid)Alkahest$() comes from the Alkahest Still, as before.

$(fluid)Anima Mundi$(): in the $(item)Essence Distillery$(), water, lava, Basaltic Magma, Deep Brine and the whole Essence of every other mod installed, twelve at a time (in parts, if there are more). New mods join in by themselves.
The $(item)Pleroma Confluence$() takes $(thing)1,000 mB$() of each of the five for 1,000 mB of Pleroma. A confluence filled under the old list is credited with the share of a batch it had gathered.
